    Profile

    Mielikki is a girl from Lustburg, living alone with her mother in the countryside. Due to her love for butterflies and flowers, she's adept at magic that deals with the world of nature. Since her only conversation partner was her mother, her speech and behavior is very childlike. She would like to improve that, but she hasn't quite managed that yet.

    Origin: Lustburg
    Gender: Female
    Height: 143cm
    Weight: 39kg
    Birthday: Jul 4
    Blood Type: Type Qe
    Zodiac: Moon of the Shimmering Dragon
    Likes: Butterflies and ribbons
    Hobbies: Raising flowers
    Illust: こめこ
    CV: 藤村歩
